subject: Junior Estimator, Infrastructure Services SA, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Junior Estimator role with Infrastructure Services in Mile End, advertised on SEEK. The ad says you'd still hear from people who don't meet every criterion, so here is where I stand.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026. The coursework covered cost estimates and bills of quantities, and road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater designs drawn in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads road and pavement guides. Reviewing drawings and putting quantities and costs against them is coursework I have done, not paid estimating work yet. My site experience is 11 months in the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020: a community hall renovation, then subdivision finishing works, where I reviewed drawings, did inspections, tracked procurement and materials, and coordinated with suppliers and subcontractors.

I haven't used Benchmark, and I use Word, Excel and PowerPoint. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd like to hear how the estimating team is set up.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.recipient_role: Sales and Estimating Manager, Infrastructure Services SA
letter.subject: Application for Junior Estimator, Infrastructure Services
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Junior Estimator role with Infrastructure Services in Mile End, advertised on SEEK and on your careers site. The ad says you would still like to hear from people who are not sure they meet every criterion, so here is where I stand and why I think the role fits.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute. The coursework covered cost estimates and bills of quantities, options analysis and risk registers, and road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage designs drawn in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads road and pavement guides. Reviewing drawings and putting quantities and costs against them is work I have done in study, not in a paid estimating role yet, and the Austroads pavement work is the closest I have come to road surfacing. Before the diploma I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines in 2019.

My site experience is 11 months in the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020: first as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation, then as field engineer on subdivision finishing works. I reviewed drawings and checked the work against them, carried out inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, kept clients and other stakeholders up to date on progress, and coordinated with engineers, suppliers and subcontractors to sort out site issues.

I have not used Benchmark, and I use Word, Excel and PowerPoint. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd like to hear how the estimating team is set up and what a junior's first year looks like.

checklist: Decide first whether you would move to Adelaide: the letter and email say "open to discussing relocation to Adelaide". If the answer is no, do not apply.

Open the Fulton Hogan Workday advert (Junior Estimator, requisition R26516, Mile End): https://fultonhogan.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/Fultonhogan/job/Mile-End/Estimator-Senior-Estimator_R26516-1 (the SEEK ad 94850442 links out to it) and press Apply.
Create or log in to the careers profile and attach the two PDFs from this record (resume and cover letter).
Answer the portal questions honestly: no estimating role yet, Subclass 485 visa to December 2027, and your real availability (the ad says immediate start available; no start date is on record).
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and "Company website".
notes: Junior estimating role; the ad lists civil construction field experience (Marc has 11 months), Microsoft Office (yes), Benchmark "highly regarded" and 12 months estimating "ideal" (both gaps, disclosed). Interstate: Adelaide relocation is Marc's call. Contact research (28 Sep 2026): Fulton Hogan publishes no SA estimating or infrastructure manager and no individual business email; only info@fultonhogan.com (not stated to take applications). The advert lives on Workday as requisition R26516 (posted 24 Sep, closes 24 Oct 2026). Portal route only.
